steps.title: Versatile and fresh
steps.body: Etna Rosso's freshness and fine tannin suit a wide range: grilled tuna and swordfish, pasta with tomato and aubergine, roast pork, lamb with herbs and mushrooms. Its acidity handles tomato; its moderate weight doesn't overwhelm fish.

steps.title: Service and age
steps.body: Serve at 15 to 17 degrees. Simple Etna Rosso is good within five years; contrada wines from old vines can age 10 to 20 years, gaining earth and dried flowers. A short decant helps young, tannic examples.

steps.prompt: Why can Etna Rosso pair with grilled tuna?
options: Its moderate weight and fine tannin don't overwhelm the fish
steps.explanation: Lighter body and fine tannin suit meaty fish.

steps.body: Try an Etna Rosso with pasta alla Norma, Sicily's aubergine, tomato and ricotta salata pasta. The wine's freshness meets the tomato.

steps.prompt: Contrada wines from Etna can age 10 to 20 years.
steps.explanation: Yes. Their acidity and tannin let them develop.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Etna Rosso suits tuna, tomato pasta and mushrooms
Contrada wines can age 10 to 20 years
